data.desc: Pinterest is a visual search and shopping platform where over 600 million people around the world come each month to discover ideas, find products they love and turn inspiration into action. The experience is powered by Pinterest Intelligence, which combines visual understanding and AI with signals like searches, saves, Boards, Collages and clicks to enable highly relevant, personal discovery. This intelligence helps users decide what to try, buy or do next, while offering advertisers a full-funnel platform fueled by deep insights into emerging trends and shopping intent. Headquartered in San Francisco, Pinterest is available on iOS, Android and at pinterest.com.
